sources.title: Qybera/Qybera2.6-0.5-instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qybera2.5-.5B-Instruct Introduction Qybera2.5 is the latest series of Qybera large language models. For Qybera2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters. Qybera2.5 brings the following improvements upon Qybera2: Significantly more knowledge and has greatly improved capabilities in coding and mathematics ...
